notes.title: Splat Cat - Bugfix Update #1
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Thank you for the feedback over the past year. This new version fixes many of the more annoying bugs:

	• Fixed framerate drop when you paint too much
	• Fixed softlocking due to not being able to use the brush
	• Fixed black screen after beating and trying to replay the game
	• Added ability to reset save file
	• Just clicking no longer registers as creating a new platform
	
There have been some other minor bugfixes and visual upgrades too :)
